{{Quote|I'm FR-D 8T-KA, translation droid specializing in Outer Rim cultures.|FR-D 8T-KA|<ref name="Star Wars 108" />}}
'''FR-D 8T-KA''', or '''FR-D''', was an [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] that specialized in cultures of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. FR-D was aboard a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that had been stolen by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] to collect [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] for retrieval of the [[Great Life Jewels]]. The remains of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] were brought onto the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], reactivating from stasis. Valance [[Death/Legends|killed]] the crew of the ship, but spared FR-D, learning of the crew's quest for the Great Life Jewels. FR-D and Valance traveled to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where the jewels were held aboard a [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Crimson Forever)|drifting]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. Valance [[Mission to retrieve the Great Life Jewels|acquired]] the jewels from the New Republic team sent to contain the [[Crimson Forever]] plague, but was shot by Tagge before [[Gender/Legends|he]] could restore himself to life. FR-D overloaded its power core, sacrificing itself to revive Valance's cyborg body in the hope that the bounty hunter could in turn save the others aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Star Wars 108" />
